title: CAVEAT: Recurrent Multimodal Diffusion Planning for Mapless Aerial Exploration
abstract: arXiv:2609.06623v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Can exploratory UAV waypoint sequences be generated from multimodal onboard observations and a fixed-dimensional recurrent internal state without maintaining a persistent global map in the deployed policy? We investigate this question through CAVEAT, a diffusion policy conditioned on a recurrent internal state updated from fused LiDAR, visual, and pose features and trained from trajectories generated by the map-based FUELv2 expert. Rolling inference partially warm-starts consecutive predictions, while a temporary local signed distance field provides heuristic obstacle guidance. Simulation results evaluate both inference mechanisms and compare CAVEAT with its demonstration-generating expert. Proof-of-concept experiments on a Flyability Elios 3 demonstrate partial exploration of a previously unseen indoor environment and target-directed visual servoing using a separately trained policy.

translated_title: CAVEAT：面向无地图空中探索的循环多模态扩散规划
translated_abstract: 部署的策略能否在不维护持久性全局地图的情况下，仅凭多模态机载观测和固定维度的循环内部状态生成无人机探索航点序列？我们通过CAVEAT来研究这一问题。CAVEAT是一种扩散策略，其条件为循环内部状态，该状态由融合的激光雷达、视觉和位姿特征进行更新，并通过基于地图的FUELv2专家生成的轨迹进行训练。滚动推理对连续预测进行部分热启动，同时临时局部有符号距离场提供启发式障碍物引导。仿真结果评估了这两种推理机制，并将CAVEAT与其生成演示数据的专家进行了比较。在Flyability Elios 3上的概念验证实验展示了对先前未见过的室内环境的部分探索，以及使用单独训练的策略实现的目标导向视觉伺服。
tldr: CAVEAT提出了一种由融合激光雷达、视觉和位姿特征驱动的循环内部状态作为条件的多模态扩散策略，无需在部署策略中维护持久全局地图即可生成无人机探索航点序列。
en_tdlr: CAVEAT introduces a multimodal diffusion policy conditioned on a recurrent internal state updated from fused LiDAR, visual, and pose features, enabling UAV exploratory waypoint generation without maintaining a persistent global map in the deployed policy.
